bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
echo TARGET_REPO_HEAD="$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)"
if ! docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1;then echo POLLER=NOT_FOUND;exit 61;fi
echo POLLER_RUNNING="$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")"
echo POLLER_RESTART_COUNT="$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$name")"
echo POLLER_IMAGE_ID="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name" | cut -c1-26)"
if docker exec "$name" test -f /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs;then
  echo VIDEO_WIZARD=FOUND
  docker exec "$name" grep -q 'legacyEditorTap' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs && echo LEGACY_CALLBACK_FIX=PRESENT || echo LEGACY_CALLBACK_FIX=MISSING
  docker exec "$name" grep -q 'Myビデオを見る' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs && echo MYVIDEOS_BUTTON=PRESENT || echo MYVIDEOS_BUTTON=MISSING
  docker exec "$name" grep -R -l -E '登録画面へ|投稿する|中止' /opt/videobot/src --include='*.mjs' 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's@/opt/videobot/src/@@' | head -n 12 || true
  docker exec "$name" sh -c 'command -v ffmpeg && command -v ffprobe' | sed -E 's@^@MEDIA_BINARY=@'
fi
echo POLLER_READY_LINE_COUNT="$(docker logs --since 72h "$name" 2>&1 | grep -c '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || true)"
echo POLLER_RUNTIME_FAILED_LINES="$(docker logs --since 72h "$name" 2>&1 | grep -Ec 'CREATOR_POLL_RUNTIME_FAILED|WIZARD_EDIT_RESULT_UNKNOWN|file exceeds Bot API download limit|preview Telegram upload failed|video too short' || true)"
echo DIAGNOSTIC_READ_ONLY=PASS
